messages:
Alex C: Quick heads-up — starting next Tuesday (7/15) we are updating the vendor onboarding & approval thresholds. Short version: more review for mid-sized SaaS purchases.
Jordan (Finance): Details here — non-capex subscriptions or services between $5,000 and $25,000 will need Procurement review + Finance >=manager sign-off. Anything > $25,000 routes to Finance Director + Procurement for negotiation. Exec approvals still required once a single-year commitment exceeds $75k. This is to align with renewed cost controls.
Maria H: Is this only new vendors or renewals too?
Jordan (Finance): Applies to both new vendors and renewals that increase annual spend above your team's current committed baseline. If it's just a price increase under an existing PO and under $5k, treat as invoice variance.
Priya S: Does this change PO generation? We usually only do POs > $2k.
Jordan (Finance): Good Q. We're raising the automatic PO requirement to invoices >= $2,500. Procurement Bot will create a PO draft when you start the vendor form. If you need manual PO earlier, email procurement@redwood.com.
Procurement Bot: Automated checklist created — please fill the onboarding form: https://confluence.redwood.com/procurement/vendor-onboarding. Attach vendor W-9/COI and sample invoice.
Alex C: Here's a quick PO template snippet you can paste into the vendor form if helpful:
```
Vendor: <vendor name>
Total Annual Value: $<amount>
Cost Center / GL: <e.g., ENG:Software:Cloud>
Contract Term: <12 months>
Renewal Auto-Renew?: <yes/no>
Procurement Contact: <name>
Finance Approver: <name>
```
Maria H: For tickets with >$25k, how long should teams expect the approval window to be? We have a partner contract expiring 8/1.
Jordan (Finance): Standard SLA is 7 business days for Procurement + Finance review (more if legal negotiation needed). For urgent renewals, flag me or Nikhil with the timeline and we can expedite.
Nikhil (CFO): FYI — this is part of a broader mid-year budget check. Teams should re-confirm committed subscriptions by 7/22 so we can lock guidance for H2. If a spend is strategic, note that in the justification field.
Priya S: Thanks — I'll start the onboarding form for the analytics vendor and tag Finance.
Maria H: :thumbsup: will update my renewal tracker.
Alex C: If anyone hits a blocker, DM Jordan or drop in #finance and we'll triage. Thanks all.
